products.title: Red Line
products.body_html:
Saudi Arabia Is a Red Line 🇸🇦

We Stand to Protect Her, From One End to the Other.

A homeland we carry in our hearts, a nation we take pride in every single day.

Out of love for Saudi Arabia, we created this bracelet as a symbol of our belonging, unity, and unwavering solidarity with our country.

A red thread wrapped around the wrist represents a line that must never be crossed. A metal piece engraved with the total area of our beloved Kingdom, from one end to the other.

More than just a bracelet, it is a statement of love, loyalty, and pride in a nation we will always stand by and protect.

Only 1 SAR.

*Because this is not about profit or fundraising. It’s about sharing a message, reaching as many people as possible, and wearing a symbol that unites us in our love for Saudi Arabia.

products.title: Desert Note
products.body_html:
One cube. One landscape. Sculpted from the textures of the Saudi desert dunes, cracked earth, or raw sand.

Each piece is unique to whoever receives it. Add oil, and it breathes. A quiet, sensory object that holds the memory of a place. Each cube is one of three possible terrains.

products.title: The Journey Within
products.body_html:
A collection of three notebooks inspired by Saudi Arabia’s diverse landscapes and the spirit of travel across land, sea, and sky.

Each cover illustration reflects a different sense of movement, from desert journeys to coastal horizons, brought together through flowing forms and layered colors.

Designed for everyday use, each notebook features a durable hardcover, lined pages, an elastic closure, and a ribbon bookmark, made to accompany your thoughts, plans, and journeys wherever they unfold.

products.title: Tanweer
products.body_html:
Tanweer is a sculptural object that stands within the home as a point of orientation، quiet, deliberate, grounded. Crafted in brushed stainless steel, it holds a flame within a precise system of enclosures and apertures, allowing light to emerge gradually into the surrounding space. The result is a calm, atmospheric glow that evolves over time، transforming a simple act into a meaningful one.

Proudly made in Saudi

products.title: Moon incense burner
products.body_html:
A quiet object with a strong presence. Moon is carved from solid teak, shaped into a sphere, and finished with a heat-resistant Saudi stone heart, made for incense sticks, charcoal, and oud. A ritual piece for the everyday.


 

Writing: "زُر دَارَ وُدٍّ إن أرَدتَ وُرُودَا زَادُوكَ وُدَّاً أن رَأوكَ وَدُودَا"

products.title: Sukoon incense burner
products.body_html:
Carved from solid teak and finished with a heat-resistant Saudi stone heart, Sukoon honors craft and natural material. Made for two rituals, incense sticks, or charcoal, and oud, bringing calm presence to the everyday.

 

Writing: "زُر دَارَ وُدٍّ إن أرَدتَ وُرُودَا زَادُوكَ وُدَّاً أن رَأوكَ وَدُودَا"

products.title: The Prayer Mat
products.body_html: Designed for life in motion, our On-the-Go Praying Mat is lightweight, waterproof, and made to move with you. Easy to carry or hang on your bag, it features Saudi-inspired illustrations rooted in heritage motifs, offering comfort and practicality wherever your day takes you, so prayer is always within reach.

products.title: Mini Roots Sets
products.body_html:
Believing that wood is a living organism, each detail of these serving plates carries its own unique beauty. Crafted from the giant roots of teak trees, every piece is patiently hand-carved and transformed into an elegant serving plate that brings warmth and character to your space.

Engraved with hand-carved calligraphy:

أشرقت وأنورت
زارتنا البركة

No two pieces are ever the same, honoring nature, craftsmanship, and the beauty of mindful living.

products.title: Rahā. Scent Diffuser
products.body_html: Inspired by the ancient rotary quern, Rahā is a modern ritual object designed to slow the moment. Hand-carved from walnut wood and Riyadh stone, Rahā brings together earth and hand, solid stone spheres resting within a circular wooden form, sealed beneath a carved lid inspired by timeless geometry. Traditionally, rotation transformed grain into sustenance. Here, stillness becomes intention. Paired with natural oil, Rahā invites touch, warmth, and quiet repetition, a grounding ritual for the hands and senses.

Teeb Playing Cards are fully illustrated by our team, inspired by the spirit and everyday beauty of Saudi life. 

Two decks come together in a sleek tin box, made for your daily play, travel, and gatherings.

Teeb Playing Cards… because play is part of our story.

products.title: Salwa Palace Building Set
products.body_html:
Salwa Palace is one of the most prominent landmarks at the district’s entrance. In 1766 AD, Imam Abdul Aziz ibn Muhammad ibn Saud built this ancient historical monument to be the home of the state and the headquarters for AlSaud’s princes and imams.

Inspired by its unique historical value and architecture, we introduce this DIY set, carefully engineered and produced to add a fun and exciting process while building it.

products.body_html:

Each backgammon set is handcrafted using durable teak wood, giving it a one-of-a-kind grain pattern. The set also features a beautiful brass inlaid board, delicately crafted with hand-carved calligraphy on the cover for a stunning finishing touch.

Calligraphy: عَلى قَدرِ أَهلِ العَزمِ تَأتي العَزائِمُ · وَتَأتي عَلى قَدرِ الكِرامِ المَكارِمُ

products.body_html:

Each soap is one-of-a-kind and presented in a beautiful leather box featuring intricate engravings inspired by Najdi palaces. The set includes six different types of soap: Oud scented, Camel milk, Moringa scented, Coffee, Date, and Olive oil.

products.title: Tower Incense Burner
products.body_html:
The tower incense burner is a concept inspired by the old mud towers. With its unique cylindrical design, we weaved the story of past Arabian trading practices that treasure the artistry of scent creation.

Calligraphy: وأنواع الأفـاويه وجوز الطـيــب والسنبل ومنها العاج والساج ومنها العود والصـنـدل

products.title: Southern Region Incense Burner
products.body_html:
This is a design inspired by traditional Arabic incense burners, which have been used throughout the ages, presented in a modern, geometric way. The piece symbolizes the Northern Saudi Region mentioned within a poem for Ghazi Abdul Rahman Al Gosaibi.

-
Calligraphy: نحن جنوبنا كبر أشدُّ
-
